summary: The human fork merged main after phase A as f2f51ea460d405f4d454f0f8a1a0080a913694d7; its tree equals 52ae6de. The first phase B attempt stopped at the old HEAD gate before any device action. B2 ran against the merge HEAD.

PASS per the executor B-launch-disposition.json and coordinator pixel inspection: both cold launches show the required diagnostic. The first helper incorrectly expected separate text nodes for a combined two-line Label and counted monkey launch time as XML polling. Its original BLOCKED records remain immutable. All post-monkey XML polling was approximately 13676 ms (2 ms rounding uncertainty), below 20000 ms; no third launch.
The template webpack config was used unchanged. The phase A Android build succeeded; the D2 fallback was not needed.

Design note for the reviewer, not a deviation: shell-content.ts computes the diagnostic text from loadConference() once at module load. The loader itself calls public normalizeConference on every invocation, with no cache, as required by the contract.
